audit.whatIsWrong: Every row of the chart disagreed with its own why. The chart read Ziggs, Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill, Ziggs while the whys read even, Ziggs, Urgot, Urgot, Urgot, Urgot, Urgot — which is exactly the packet levelChart. A reader was told level 3 was even while the text beside it said 'W Purge's move-speed and Q slow let you close and flip the lane to you'.
audit.why: At 51.36% over 697 games the lane is: an even level 1, one genuinely bad level-2 window where Bouncing Bomb outranges everything you have, then Urgot from 3 onward because a fragile artillery mage dies whenever a Juggernaut reaches him.
audit.corrected: All seven rows rewritten in both layers to Skill, Ziggs, Urgot, Urgot, Urgot, Urgot, Urgot with ratings to match, and phases[1].why rewritten to explain the level-2 window instead of claiming Urgot wins it.

audit.why: Spike placement is right — Ziggs peaks at level 2 max-range poke, Urgot at 3 with the gap-close, at 6 with the execute, and at first item. The 20s Satchel Charge cooldown is the real gate on every all-in and it is now stated with a number.
audit.corrected: Timings kept; spikes[0] and spikes[1] text corrected.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page tells the player three times — spikes[0].text, content.mid and wants.you[0] — to use 'W Purge's move-speed' or a 'movement-speed cleanse' to sprint through Ziggs's zone. Urgot's W does the opposite: Riot's text says 'Urgot slows himself while he unloads his weapon'. There is no move speed and no cleanse on it. Satchel Charge's max-health damage and Short Fuse's auto-reset were also never mentioned.
audit.why: This inverted the entire gap-closing plan: a player following it walks into 850-range bombs while self-slowed. The correct order is Q slow and E Disdain to close, then W-lock once you are already on him. Satchel Charge (20/18/16/14/12s) is flagged percentHealth, so stacking raw HP does not blunt it, and Short Fuse is an auto-attack reset.
audit.corrected: All three move-speed claims removed and replaced with the correct sequencing; spikes[1] now states Satchel Charge as the real answer with its 20s cooldown and max-health damage; dosFull[2].d, dontsFull[0].d and dontsFull[1].d carry the cooldown, the reset tell and the percent-health rule.

edits.before: E or W second depending on kill pressure. A landed E-flip into W spray already wins most level-2 exchanges outright.
edits.after: E or W second depending on kill pressure. Bouncing Bomb outranges you at 850 and you have no gap-closer yet — level 2 is his.

edits.before: Early Ziggs pokes hard with Q Bouncing Bomb from max range, so eat minimal free bombs. But once you hit 3 and get W Purge for the movement-speed cleanse plus your Q slow, you close the gap — Q the ground, W to sprint through his zone, and E Disdain onto him. He has no escape once you're on top.
edits.after: Early Ziggs pokes hard with Q Bouncing Bomb from 850 range, so eat minimal free bombs. Purge slows you while it fires, so close the gap FIRST — Q the ground to slow him, E Disdain onto him, and only then W-lock. Once you are on top he has no escape but his Satchel.

edits.before: At 3 you flip it: W Purge's move-speed plus your Q slow let you sprint his zone and E onto him, and he has no reliable escape. Through 6 you dominate every time you reach melee range — bait the satchel, then dive.
edits.after: At 3 you flip it: your Q slow and E Disdain close the gap, and once you are in melee he has no reliable escape. Through 6 you dominate every time you reach him cleanly — bait the Satchel, then dive.

edits.before: W Purge's move-speed to sprint through his Q zone
edits.after: Q slow and E Disdain to close his 850 Q range

edits.before: His R Mega Inferno Bomb is waveclear and long-range chip, not a duel button — it won't save him when you're in melee. Your R Fear Beyond Death flips and executes him through his W Satchel knockback if you time it after he blows the satchel. Bait the satchel, then dive.
edits.after: His R Mega Inferno Bomb is waveclear and long-range chip, not a duel button — it won't save him when you're in melee. Satchel Charge is his real answer: 20s at rank 1, it knocks you away and deals max-health damage. Bait it out, then flip and execute.

edits.before: Ziggs wastes Satchel Charge — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Satchel Charge is 20s at rank 1 — that is your whole all-in window.

edits.before: That is Ziggs's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Short Fuse resets his auto — the wind-up is the tell, not the bomb itself.

edits.before: Burning your answer for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Satchel deals max-health damage — stacking raw HP does not blunt it.

notes: The 'W Purge's move-speed / movement-speed cleanse' claim was the serious error here — Urgot's W self-slows, so the page was telling the player to close a 850-range poke gap using an ability that makes them slower, and calling it a cleanse when it removes nothing. Removed from all three places. Also dropped the unverifiable claim that Urgot's R 'executes him through his W Satchel knockback': whether the impale survives a displacement is not in Riot's text, so I replaced it with the bait-then-flip sequencing that is correct either way. Note the tone/diff mismatch for the user: diff is 'EVEN' but tone is the red #ff5d6c and report[14] says 'Hard matchup — difficulty 7/10' on a 51.36% matchup where Urgot now owns five of seven rows. I left those champion-level judgement fields alone.
